claim_text: 來源機構：ACM Transactions on Computing Education (ACM)；資料標題：Interaction Patterns and Embodied Design Processes Using an AI Robotics Kit for K–12 Education；來源刊登日：2026-10-15。作者摘要報告：研究探討兒童如何與一款透過動手製作教授機器學習（ML）概念的低成本教育機器人工具互動；研究者帶領三次介入，參與兒童分別為 10、11、13 歲，各自以該套件打造一台加入 AI 的機器人，並以質性分析與流程探勘方法分析介入中的互動。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Interaction Patterns and Embodied Design Processes Using an AI Robotics Kit for K–12 Education
source_locator: ACM Digital Library 文章頁（管理者 2026-10-16 截圖）：Just Accepted；Accepted on 17 September 2026；Online AM: 15 October 2026；出版者 PDF（Just Accepted 版，管理者提供）：ACM 1946-6226/2026/10-ART；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 1、3、4 句（出版者網頁對自動請求回 403）
original_excerpt: This multidisciplinary study explores how children interact with a low-cost robotics educational tool designed to teach machine learning (ML) concepts through hands-on making. … We conducted three researcher-led interventions with children aged 10, 11 and 13, each tasked to build an AI-enhanced robot using the robotics kit. … Interventions were analyzed both qualitatively and with process mining methods to gain an in-depth view of the interactions.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究目的、設計與分析方法；介入研究，依規則不寫結果。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（ACM Transactions on Computing Education，監測清單 J14），Just Accepted 版；小規模質性研究，三次介入各 1 名兒童（共 3 人，內文 2.3 節），經監護人招募，非學校情境；本則不涉及結果。
ai_lit_note: 兒童以機器人套件動手學機器學習概念、打造 AI 機器人，對應 S-BAS「理解AI運作原理與限制」
summary_evidence_spans: This multidisciplinary study explores how children interact with a low-cost robotics educational tool designed to teach machine learning (ML) concepts through hands-on making.
We conducted three researcher-led interventions with children aged 10, 11 and 13, each tasked to build an AI-enhanced robot using the robotics kit.
Interventions were analyzed both qualitatively and with process mining methods to gain an in-depth view of the interactions.
